examples.label: Résumé upload on a job application
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="apply-resume" name="application[resume]" label="Attach your résumé (PDF or Word, up to 5 MB)" class="max-w-md" />

examples.label: Profile photo field rejecting an oversized image
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="profile-avatar-upload" name="user[avatar]" label="Profile photo" errors={["That image is larger than 2 MB. Please choose a smaller file."]} class="max-w-md" />

examples.label: Receipt attachment on an expense claim
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-file-field" site="Global" id="expense-receipt" name="expense[receipt]" label="Receipt or invoice" color="primary" space="small" class="max-w-md" />
